speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned you have a limp and localized pain without fever; can you tell me exactly where the pain is located and if you were doing anything specific like playing or falling right before it started?

speaker: Patient
text: 7-year-old male. Mother has noticed a change in the child’s play patterns, specifically favoring his left leg while walking or running. The child complains of pain in his left knee, but denies any recent trauma or injury. He has no fever or other systemic symptoms. Nutrition and developmental milestones are appropriate for age.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Oligoarticular JIA).
